note: Set A is better because it correctly extracts the Junction Box details and the full cable specification (USE-2), whereas Set B truncates the cable spec and omits the Junction Box. Set B makes numerous unsupported claims that the diagram symbol '3' represents voltage, which contradicts the legend defining it as a module identifier; Set A interprets '3' as quantity, which is also likely a misinterpretation of the legend key but less severe than inventing voltage values. Both sets truncate the PV module model name (GX2 vs GX290) and Set A incorrectly attributes the UV rating to the cable instead of cable ties.
